25732: (define (kth_smallest_select nums k)	;; Base case.	(if (null? nums)		0		;; Recursive case.		(let* ([pivot (car nums)]			   ;; Find positions of elements smaller than the pivot,			   ;; those greater than the pivot, and those equal to the pivot.			   [small_pos (filter (lambda (x) (< x pivot)) (cdr nums))]			   [mid_pos (filter (lambda (x) (= x pivot)) (cdr nums))]			   [large_pos (filter (lambda (x) (> x pivot)) (cdr nums))])			;; Check if the pivot is the kth element.			(cond				[(= 1 (length mid_pos)) pivot]				;; If the pivot is not the kth element, select the kth element of				;; the set of elements smaller than the pivot.				[(< k (length small_pos)) (kth_smallest_select small_pos k)]				;; If the pivot is not the kth element, select the kth element of				;; the set of elements greater than the pivot.				[else (+ pivot (kth_smallest_select large_pos (- k (length small_pos) (length mid_pos))))]))))
